# RCTailcat transport manifest

- Tailcat repository: `https://github.com/tailscale/tailcat`
- Tailcat commit: `88929418b1a3f3c74904a3136d6a9e87b1b5b9bb`
- Tailscale dependency commit: `246c82a658b3`
- RemoteCode patch: `patches/tailcat-88929418-rcpatch1.patch`
- Transport build ID: `tailcat-88929418b1a3f3c74904a3136d6a9e87b1b5b9bb+rcpatch1`
- Toolchain: Go 1.26.5
- Slices: macOS arm64 (minimum 14.0), iOS arm64 (minimum 18.0), iOS Simulator arm64 (minimum 18.0)
- Exported API: `RCTailcatBuildID`, `RCTailcatGeneratePrivateKey`, `RCTailcatPublicKey`, `RCTailcatServerStart`, `RCTailcatServerStartWithDERP`, `RCTailcatServerClose`, `RCTailcatClientStart`, `RCTailcatClientStatus`, `RCTailcatClientClose`, `RCTailcatFree`
- Server relay contract: `RCTailcatServerStartWithDERP` embeds RegionID 1 with `derp.remotecode.io` (`82.25.69.175`), DERP TCP 444, and STUN UDP 3478 in the primary ConnBlob; `RCTailcatServerStart` pins the public RegionID 301 fallback.
- Server port contract: Tailcat clients target frozen service port 18217; the `loopbackPort` C argument is only the per-launch Swift forwarding listener and is never used to authorize the requested Tailcat service port.
- Licenses: Tailcat and Tailscale license texts are in `Licenses/`.

The XCFramework is generated by `build-xcframework.sh`. It is deliberately not committed until the Apple physical-device feasibility gate passes.
